request.style: English, solo male baritone voice, acoustic guitar, steel guitar, fiddle, upright bass, warm and nostalgic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Penuel was the father of Gedor
Ezer the father of Hushah
Sons of Hur the firstborn
Of Ephrathah the father of Bethlehem

[Chorus]
Gedor in the hill country
A name in the line of Judah
A place in the ancient land
Where the genealogies are drawn

[Verse]
Mered's wife bore Jered
The father of Gedor
Son of Bithiah Pharaoh's daughter
In the lineage of the tribe

[Chorus]
Gedor in the hill country
A name in the line of Judah
A place in the ancient land
Where the genealogies are drawn

[Bridge]
They went to the entrance of Gedor
To the east side of the valley
Looking for pasture for their flocks
In the quiet of the hill

[Chorus]
Gedor in the hill country
A name in the line of Judah
A place in the ancient land
Where the genealogies are drawn

[Outro]
The land was broad and quiet
And peaceful for their sheep
